slice: P3 AC1027 unmarked MATERIAL diffuse-map Scene-to-File plus filename transaction

scope.profile: One unchanged runtime-authored AC1027 MATERIAL profile with a complete diffuse/refraction prefix, inferred complete normal tuple, both outer group-72 source fields, and both group-3 filenames.
scope.operation: Change the selected diffuse source from 0 to 1 and replace only its group-3 filename in the same export transaction.
scope.encodingMatrix: ASCII and binary source, each exported as ASCII and binary DXF.

contract.admission: Only the selected unchanged source profile is admitted. Diffuse source 0-to-1 requires a simultaneous diffuse filename edit. Standalone diffuse selector changes, procedural fields, luminance/explicit normal-strength profiles, other typed edits, changed raw bodies, and unsupported source profiles remain refused.
contract.output: The physical output writes the first group-72 selector as 1 and the first group-3 filename as requested, retaining the second selector and filename and other checked map fields. Fresh libdxfrw readback matches the full represented model.
contract.atomicity: Changing the captured first group-72 raw value to a conflicting value refuses while preserving the destination sentinel and caller's requested source/file values. Restoring the captured raw body permits same-adapter retry and successful readback. A selector-only attempt also refuses without replacing the destination.

sourceBindings.fixture: Generated at runtime by tests/material_normal_role_tests.cpp from scratch; no DWG/DXF fixture is committed.

validation.focusedControls: Four positive ASCII/binary source/output combinations with exact physical fields and readback; four selector-only refusals; four conflicting-source refusals with destination/caller preservation and same-adapter retries.

references.title: Autodesk MaterialMap Source enumeration
references.use: The enum members are Scene, File, Procedural in that order; this supports the selected 0-to-1 field transition.

limitations: This proves selected DXF field transport, identity, readback, refusal, rollback, and retry only. It does not prove native image lookup, file availability, map evaluation, rendering, or whole-document conversion.
No diffuse selector-only transaction, procedural-source coupling, other source-profile boundary, other version, DWG path, or support claim is promoted.
